catalogue.note: Rebuilt from a screenshot (image2code), not from Figma layers; the diff is against that screenshot scaled to 560 wide and is indicative only. The screenshot is the same 560-wide checkout as the inherited screens, captured at 80% browser zoom and enlarged in Figma (1.6 source pixels per layout pixel, so nothing is measured finer than 0.6px). Header, type styles, the Invoice overview pill, log rows, buttons and the input fields carry the Figma-exact values of the inherited screens; block positions, the header gradient and the newer parts are measured. Not recovered: the avatar (logo-slot is an empty placeholder circle); the icon inside the scan button; the exact typeface release and letter I / l in the invoice ID. Status icons, arrow, spinner and tick are drawn, not traced. Frame chrome (rounded outer corners) is left off. Diff leaves out the avatar, the outer corners. The email address in the screenshot is a real person's: the code shows alex@email.com instead, and in source/figma.png the address is covered with a flat patch of the input's white (that patch is left out of the diff too). The screenshot starts 3px below the top of the header; the build keeps the full 110px header, so it is 3px taller than the picture.
